title: Post-Hoc Uncertainty-Aware Explanations for Deployed Power Quality Disturbance Classifiers via Laplace Approximation
abstract: arXiv:2604.13658v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep learning classifiers achieve high accuracy in power quality disturbance (PQD) recognition, but existing explanation methods return a single deterministic attribution map and provide no measure of its reliability. This paper develops a post-hoc Bayesian explanation (B-explanation) method for trained PQD classifiers. A computationally efficient Laplace approximation converts the trained network into an approximate parameter posterior without retraining, and occlusion sensitivity is propagated through posterior samples to produce a distribution over disturbance-localization maps. translated_title: 针对已部署电能质量扰动分类器的后验不确定性感知解释方法——基于拉普拉斯近似
translated_abstract: 深度学习分类器在电能质量扰动（PQD）识别中达到了高准确率，但现有的解释方法仅返回单一的确定性归因图，且无法提供其可靠性的度量。本文开发了一种针对已训练PQD分类器的后验贝叶斯解释（B-explanation）方法。通过计算高效的拉普拉斯近似，将训练好的网络转换为近似的参数后验分布，而无需重新训练；随后，将遮挡敏感性传播至后验样本，以生成扰动定位图的分布。该分布的百分位数汇总产生具有无分布覆盖带的解释：在低百分位数下的共识汇总能显著增强对特征性事件（如电压暂降、暂升和振荡瞬变）的定位清晰度，带宽指示了每个归因的可靠性，而其余扰动类型则显示出类别差异。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于拉普拉斯近似的后验贝叶斯解释方法，为已部署的电能质量扰动分类器提供带可靠性度量的不确定性感知解释，无需重新训练即可增强特征性事件的定位清晰度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a post-hoc Bayesian explanation method via Laplace approximation that provides uncertainty-aware explanations with reliability measures for deployed power quality disturbance classifiers, sharpening localization for distinctive events without retraining.
